note: Proposed pass targets. They are the maintainer's decision: approve or change them here, set status to approved with approved_by, and only then run the held-out half. Thresholds are the trial P(yes) cut-offs for the on-trial questions; a passing run freezes them into the acceptance record.
cut_rule: A question is cut when its agreement with gold is below question_agreement_min, or when it catches no research-visible failure and finds no planted clue that the rules missed. An on-trial question (C2, C3) is kept only when its planted recall meets on_trial_planted_recall_min.
choose: Among contenders that meet every target on the held-out half: fewest lost leads, then most research-visible failures caught, then lowest cost per 100 leads. Rules only is the baseline and is never chosen as the backend.
